package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"sync/atomic"

	"example.invalid/worker"
)

var stop atomic.Uint32

func spin(started, finished chan struct{}) {
	fmt.Println("worker-entered")
	close(started)
again:
	if stop.Load() == 0 {
		goto again
	}
	close(finished)
}

func recoverSemantics() (value int) {
	defer func() {
		var rounds atomic.Uint32
	again:
		if rounds.Add(1) < 2048 {
			goto again
		}
		if recover() != "marker" || rounds.Load() != 2048 {
			panic("recover changed")
		}
		value = 42
	}()
	panic("marker")
}

func labelSemantics() int {
	n := 0
outer:
	for {
		n++
		if n < 2 {
			continue outer
		}
		break outer
	}
	goto forward
back:
	n++
	if n < 4 {
		goto back
	}
forward:
	if n < 3 {
		goto back
	}
	return n
}

func main() {
	runtime.GOMAXPROCS(1)
	started, finished := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		panic("expected app or dependency")
	}
	switch os.Args[1] {
	case "semantics":
		if recoverSemantics() != 42 || labelSemantics() != 4 {
			panic("control flow changed")
		}
		fmt.Println("semantic-preserved")
		return
	case "app":
		go spin(started, finished)
		<-started
		stop.Store(1)
	case "dependency":
		go worker.Spin(started, finished)
		<-started
		worker.Stop.Store(1)
	default:
		panic("unexpected mode")
	}
	<-finished
	fmt.Println("sibling-progress")
}
